plan_reconciliation.reason: The current F1 and Verification 1.1 use the common measurable probability-one continuity event as part of the supplied Brownian-motion interface. def-brownian-motion was added to bind that semantic interface explicitly after the terminal repair; no other planned dependency was removed.

Current L4 and Verification 1.1--2.2 use the Bochner integrability criterion for both integrability of the scalar norm and the single L1 simple approximation. The theorem is therefore an authored proof dependency missing from the earlier plan.

Current L2 and Verification 1.1 use the James-formula lemma for the ell2-to-J norm estimate and the defining finite variation formula. The lemma was made an explicit dependency rather than leaving that interface implicit.

The normalized clutching proof uses transition-cocycle gluing to pass between the clutching presentation and bundle isomorphism data. thm-vector-bundles-glued-from-transition-cocycles is now declared alongside the originally planned stable-complement and homotopy interfaces.

The current polynomial-clutching proof invokes AC and the bundle-homotopy and cocycle interfaces when turning a polynomial clutching family into an isomorphic bundle family. Those three load-bearing interfaces were added to the actual dependency list.

The completed Laurent-approximation proof concerns normalized bundle automorphisms and their homotopies, not the K-theory external product. def-external-product-in-complex-k-theory was removed because it has no current use; the retained dependencies supply the normalization and analytic approximation steps.

Current F1 and Verification 1.1 and 9.1 use the external-product definition to specify the natural ring map mu. It was omitted from the plan but is an essential authored interface, so it is now declared.

Current L2 and Verification 1.1 use completeness of real c0 to take the uniform limit of a James-norm Cauchy sequence. The former planned closed-subspace lemma does not supply that conclusion and was replaced by lem-real-and-complex-c-zero-are-banach.

Current F2 and Verification 1.1 use the disk and sphere subspaces for the pulled-back metric to type the induced map of pairs. def-disk-sphere-and-thom-space-of-a-metric-vector-bundle was added to record that actual proof use.
